snippet.title: DREAD FIELDS - Reveal Trailer [Rural Horror]
snippet.description:
Wishlist DREAD FIELDS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4258770/Dread_Fields/

Feed the animals, tend the fields, and keep the house clean while living dead girls wander nearby. A slow-burn rural horror.

"Life in the big city has become too tiring and stressful for me.
I have decided to sell my apartment and move to the countryside.
A strange old man sold me a house with a small farm in the middle of nowhere.
I hope that a measured life, physical labor, and fresh air will bring happiness back to my life."

Twitter (X): https://x.com/podoba_interact
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/podoba
